comment: Authorized, human-verified soil reports and their ground truth (schema v2; validated by `python -m eval.ocr_eval --validate-only`). Add real reports under eval/dataset/ - never commit a report you are not authorized to share. See eval/README.md for exactly which samples are still missing. Values use the report's own unit; omit a parameter the report does not print. Bound readings such as '>5' are strings. `unit_stated` = the report prints a unit directly beside that value. `recorded_on` is the date the ground truth was recorded in this manifest, not necessarily the date it was checked against the paper report.

documents.laboratory: Nitte - RuTAGe Smart Village Center (RSVC), Soil Health Card, single page, two-column layout
documents.authorization: Committed to this repository by the project owner as a test fixture. Written permission from the laboratory / farmer to use it for evaluation is NOT recorded, and the card's own disclaimer forbids reproduction without the laboratory's written approval.
documents.verified_by: project owner (values asserted in tests/test_ocr_pipeline.py::test_pipeline_hegde_report); not independently re-checked by a second person
documents.notes: unit_stated flags were read by the harness author from the card's text layer (unit printed on the same line as the value); the values themselves are the owner's.
